title: Brush Up: The 5-Minute Daily News - AI/Tech, Biz, World
description: Your definitive morning intelligence download. Every day shortly after 7:00 AM EST, we bypass the noise to deliver the critical shifts in AI, Global Business, and Macroeconomics that define the modern landscape. Brush up on the news while you brush up your smile.
latestSummary:
OpenAI secured a $3 billion funding round led by Amazon, Nvidia, and SoftBank, valuing the company at $852 billion as it prepares for a potential IPO. Simultaneously, Salesforce is integrating AI into Slack with 30 new features. Cybersecurity threats remain a major concern, with a cyberattack targeting LiteLLM and North Korean hackers exploiting Axios for malware distribution.

The Federal Reserve Chair warned about unsustainable U.S. national debt, while Tesla anticipates a drop in first-quarter deliveries due to reduced EV demand. Global energy markets are easing with oil prices declining due to de-escalated Middle East conflicts.

In the Middle East, Israel intensified attacks in Lebanon, aiming to maintain control over southern Lebanon. China is attempting a diplomatic role in the Iran war. A Russian An-26 plane crashed in Crimea, killing 29, and a U.S. journalist was kidnapped in Baghdad.

title: Overnight Market Brief - Bridging the Global Gap. Daily.
description:
While North America sleeps, the global economy keeps moving. Overnight Market Brief is your essential pre-market digest, designed for traders, serious investors, and professionals who need to hit the ground running.
Most North American investors miss 50% of the market story because it happens in Tokyo, Hong Kong, and London. We bridge that gap. Every morning at 8:00 AM ET, we deliver a concise, data-driven breakdown and full global picture in under 10 minutes, just in time for your morning commute.
latestSummary:
Global markets opened positively on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, following a strong risk-on session on Wall Street, driven by hopes for de-escalation in the Iran conflict. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 rose significantly, while the 10-Year Treasury Yield fell sharply, contributing to a weaker US Dollar and a surge in gold prices. Crude oil prices also retreated.

Asia experienced unified gains, with major indices in Tokyo, Greater China, and Hong Kong reflecting the positive sentiment. Europe’s market reaction was mixed, with cautious resilience despite downgraded growth forecasts and manufacturing contraction due to geopolitical pressures. However, a high manufacturing PMI in Germany offered a counterpoint.

US equity futures are currently trading higher, with the Nasdaq 100 futures showing particular strength, aligning with declining bond yields. Investors are closely watching geopolitical developments surrounding the Iran conflict, European economic data releases, and central bank commentary regarding GBP and JPY rates. The market appears to favor continued upward movement, contingent on avoiding unexpected developments in these key areas.

title: Post-market Recap
description:
Did the market "rally into the close" or "fade the open"? The Post-Market Recap goes beyond the green and red arrows to analyze the structure of the trading day. This daily briefing dissects the inter-market correlations that drove the session.
Every afternoon, we cover:
Macro Causality: Connecting the dots between the 10-Year Yield, the Dollar Index, and Equities.
Tech & AI Pulse: A dedicated segment on the semiconductor ecosystem and Big Tech performance.
Market Breadth: Analyzing Volatility (VIX) and Sector Rotation to gauge genuine institutional sentiment.
Closing Catalysts: Identifying the specific news and data that triggered late-day reversals.
latestSummary:
The Post-Market Recap by AGI Era on March 31, 2026, reported a decisive bullish session across major indices. The S&P 500 surged 2.91% to 6528.52, the Nasdaq 100 rose 3.43% to 23740.19, and the Dow Jones climbed 1125.37 points. Elevated trading volume, particularly in technology, fueled this movement, indicating strong institutional buying.

The “Fear Gauge” (VIX) decreased slightly to 30.61, reflecting a risk-on environment despite underlying caution. Sector rotation favored technology (XLK.US, up 4.24%) over utilities (XLU.US, down 0.09%), signaling a shift towards growth-oriented investments.

Key drivers included a decline in the 10-Year Treasury Yield to 4.313%, easing pressure on growth stocks and boosting tech valuations. A weakening US Dollar Index and falling crude oil prices (around $101.57) further supported the risk-on sentiment, influenced by de-escalation hopes regarding the Iran conflict.

Artificial intelligence and Big Tech stocks led the gains, with Nvidia (up 5.62%), Microsoft (up 3.12%), Apple (up 2.92%), Alphabet (up 5.14%), Amazon (up 3.66%), Meta (up 6.60%), and Tesla (up 4.64%) all experiencing significant increases.

After-hours trading saw some pullback in Nvidia and Apple, while Amphenol and Interactive Brokers showed gains. Investors will be closely watching the 4.30% level on the 10-Year Treasury Yield and any geopolitical developments tomorrow.

title: Geopolitical Updates
description: Beyond the headlines lies strategy. Geopolitical Updates is your daily guide to the evolving global order. Each episode provides a rapid scan of the day's top international stories, followed by a deep-dive analysis of the single most impactful event shifting the geopolitical landscape. From tension in the South China Sea to economic statecraft in Europe, we explain not just what happened today, but why it matters for tomorrow. Delivered daily at 7 PM ET.
latestSummary:
Israel’s declaration to maintain control over southern Lebanon following the conflict with Hezbollah is the dominant geopolitical story today. This includes plans to demolish homes near the border, raising concerns about sovereignty and regional stability. Simultaneously, disturbing reports emerged of Iran using child soldiers, resulting in an eleven-year-old’s death. A U.S. journalist, Shelly Kittleson, was kidnapped in Baghdad with suspected ties to Kataib Hezbollah, further complicating U.S.-Iran relations.

The UN peacekeeping mission in Lebanon suffered casualties with two Indonesian peacekeepers killed by a roadside explosion, adding to the existing death of another Indonesian peacekeeper.  Meanwhile, a Russian oil tanker successfully delivered fuel to Cuba, ending a blockade and demonstrating continued Russian support.  Economically, migrant workers in Asia are facing deadly risks in Gulf states due to Iranian strikes, and fuel shortages are deepening in Myanmar.  Analysts believe Israel’s actions are being used as a negotiating tool, potentially reshaping Lebanon’s border and creating a permanent Israeli presence, with significant implications for regional power dynamics and international relations.
